tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

1.Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

2.It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission
3.EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection
4.Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
5.Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory

6.It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission

7.The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder send.
8.Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per KPPP
10.Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
11.Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
13.The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake
14.Financial Turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26
15.All the work done certificate uploaded should include E-procurement indent number
16.Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 1.The bidder must be a company registered under the Companies Act 2013,1956 or registered under the Indian Partnership Act 1932 or a Limited Liability Partnership registered under the LLP Act 2008, or Society/Trust registered under societies Act 1960, or sole proprietorship. The bidder must submit Proof of Registration of the legal entity Certificate of Incorporation, PAN Card, GSTIN, Udyog Aadhar, etc. OR Bidder should upload the Class-3 and Above License issued by PWD and competent Authority

3.Should have experience in last 05 years as on bid due date Experience in Operation and Maintenance of any Digital fee collection for vendors, Housekeeping ,Solid waste management ,Garden management ,Event management Construction works. Joint Venture Allowed Joint venturer Should possess atleast one similar nature of work done certificate and shoud have own registered company certificate
2.Should have an Average Annual Turnover of INR 20.00 Lakhs in the last three Financial Years .

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 4.The Bidder shall briefly present their experience with similar assignments where they have operated and maintained market.
ESI, PF and Group insurance of Minimum of 10 persons.
